This chapter follows one step from caller through MeshBlock or Mesh to the kernels, then maps storage, configuration, Python bindings and external dependencies. Its evidence is pinned source and explicitly identified tests; it makes no new runtime performance or convergence claim.

The dependency map is a call-ownership map. Numerical switch implications remain pending the editor-owned @sec-ch12-matrix.
